name: aqg-project-status
description: Render a project's AQG ledger as a human-facing status report — a business progress overview (milestone stage table, completion bar, rule-based health light, pending-decision open-decision list) plus the engineering detail (progress timeline, open defect ledger / Bug ledger, delivery-handbook index), aggregated per target repo from the local append-only events.jsonl. Repo-read-only (drains the local ledger on view; --no-drain to skip); default HTML (also markdown / text / json). Use when asked how a project is progressing, to view its business milestones or Bug ledger, or to produce a project status / progress report.

sentence_patterns: What's the status / progress of this project?
Show me the open bugs (defect ledger) for this repo
Render a project status report (progress + handbooks)
这个项目做到哪了, 给我一份进度报告

cli_contract.0: success — report rendered to stdout (an empty / missing ledger is a successful empty report)
cli_contract.1: reserved — ledger state is surfaced in the report, not via the exit code
cli_contract.2: usage error — argparse exit 2 on bad args, incl. --json combined with --format; also the How-To-Run wrapper's exit when it cannot source _aqg_context.sh
cli_contract.3: config error — cannot resolve the AQG contracts (AQG_ROOT / partial checkout) or the project_id
cli_contract.70: backstop — unexpected internal error while building the report

owner_only_actions: Production / secrets / branch protection / Owner-admin actions remain separate authorization gates

cases.prompt: How far along is this project? Give me a progress report
Show me the open bugs / defect ledger for this repo
Generate a project status report — progress timeline plus delivery handbooks
What's the progress on this project, and what bugs are still open?
Use /aqg-project-status to render this project's ledger
